# Cross-link and embed option gates

Cross-links are recognized only when their option is enabled.

```````````````````````````````` example cross-link
[[reference]]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:13 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:13 children=1
    └── CrossLink scope=1:1..1:13 reference="reference" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[[reference]]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:13 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:13 children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:13 literal="[[reference]]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Embeds are independently recognized only when their option is enabled.

```````````````````````````````` example embed
![[reference]]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:14 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:14 children=1
    └── Embed scope=1:1..1:14 reference="reference" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
![[reference]]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:14 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:14 children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:14 literal="![[reference]]" children=0
````````````````````````````````
